subject: MCA | RET | Banking Program | Stages: AA_Required,AA_ALT_MOBILE_REQUIRED,SETTLEMENT_BANK_UPDATE_REQUIRED,ESIGN_INITIATE,ESIGN_REINITIATE | Banner Request

custom_fields.cf_s:
AA_Required Stage: "This process is to access last 4 months of bank statement of the merchant - regulated & approved by RBI - doing this on behalf of lender - lender quote has to be in all coms here
When merchant comes on this screen - he has to share some information on anumati screen which will open in loan journey only
1. Mobile number - validation means - OTP
2. Bank account customer has to select after validation from bank

Push Communication:
Title:⚡Loan Progress Paused – Action Needed
Body: To proceed with your loan, enter the OTP sent to your Paytm number and approve consent to fetch bank statements securely ✅

2)AA_ALT_MOBILE_REQUIRED-if AA fails after consent receive 
Here we will have to tell the merchant thet he has to share an alternate mobile / alternate bank account details number to proceed - will be filled in loan journey screen on paytm app only.
Mismatch in phone number linked with your bamk account and paytm account.
Provide bank account which is linked to your mobile number updated in paytm records.

Push Communication- "
Title: Alternate Mobile Number Required
Body: Mobile number linked to your bank doesn’t match Paytm records. 
Enter a bank account linked with your Paytm number.


3)SETTLEMENT_BANK_UPDATE_REQUIRED-here setttlement bank account is not updated in our records - merchant has to change update settlement bank account - we have last 4 digits and bank name, account type

To share these details with merchant we need these details to flow in LO e
